title.narrative: Safe Abortion Action Fund (SAAF) Round 6

description.narrative: The Safe Abortion Action Fund (SAAF) is the only international fund focused exclusively on the right to safe and legal abortion.We envision a world where women, girls and people with diverse gender identities have their human rights to abortion and bodily autonomy respected, protected and fulfilled. Through our funding and support we work to de-stigmatize abortion and to create opportunities for organisations working on abortion to connect with like-minded partners, with the goal of supporting a thriving intersectional movement to advance reproductive rights for all, especially communities which experience marginalisation.

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who report increased resources or abilities to effectively achieve their objectives, mission and vision, counter threats and seize opportunities.

title.narrative: Outcome 1: Advances in policy environments that support gender equity and people's ability to exercise abortion rights
O1.1Number of grantee partners contributing to improved policy environments for abortion rights

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who have made progress towards improved policy environments that support gender equity and people's ability to exercise abortion rights.

title.narrative: Outcome 4: Evidence and knowledge-sharing that support effective strategies for abortion access and rights
O4.1Number of grantee partners engaged in evidence and knowledge sharing

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who engage in evidence and knowledge sharing activities related to advancing abortion rights.

title.narrative: Outcome 6: More vibrant civil societymovements working for safe abortion rights
O6.1Number of grantee partners reporting increased engagement with movements for abortion rights

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who report increased knowledge, motivation or ability to take collective action for safe abortion rights or those who report new/strengthened strategic engagement with others to build collective power for abortion rights movements.

title.narrative: Outcome 3: Changes in community norms & attitudes that support bodily autonomy and everyone's right to safe abortion
O3.1Number of grantee partners contributing to more positive community norms and attitudes towards safe abortion within communities

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who report positive shifts in personal attitudes and social norms which are related to issues relevant to safe abortion, including bodily autonomy, gender equality and other structural drivers.

title.narrative: Outcome 5: Access to quality abortion optionsfor women, girls and people withdiverse gender identities
O5.3Number of health workers trained to provide safe abortion support through a diverse range of models.

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of health workers trained to provide safe abortion and post-abortion support through a diverse range of models. This includes direct service delivery within healthcare facilities as well as clinical supervision of harm reduction or telehealth approaches.

title.narrative: O5.4 Number of grantee partners contributing to increased quality of abortion options

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who report contributing to increased quality of available abortion options and post-abortion care. It is intended to account for grantee partners' achievements in the area, and not for SAAF to directly assess clinical quality of abortion/post-abortion care.

title.narrative: O5.2Number of grantee partners supporting people with abortion or post-abortion care

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of grantee partners who support people in accessing safe abortion options and post-abortion care, either within the healthcare setting or through self-care models.

title.narrative: O5.1Number of people supported with abortion or post-abortion care

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of people who were supported by grantee partners to access safe abortion options and post-abortion care, either within the healthcare setting or through self-care models.
